title: No circuit overlaps; Q8's 3-net fails; 3-nets that compose like cycles are abelian p-groups
subject: Whether the 3-net of Q8 composes like cycles, and whether a circuit of a law that composes like cycles can overlap modulo the tops
conclusion: In a law that composes like cycles no circuit overlaps modulo the tops, so composing like cycles is exactly having Latin circuits (multiary quasigroups) modulo proper pp-definable equivalences, while Mal'tsev structure on the tops stays open. The 3-net of the quaternion group Q8 fails through Thomsen's configuration, whose top image is the non-affine relation behind the earlier certificate, and a Latin square's 3-net composes like cycles exactly when the square is isotopic to an abelian p-group.
